scripts.build: npm run build -w @cipher-party/game-core && npm run build -w @cipher-party/protocol && npm run build -w @cipher-party/web && npm run build -w @cipher-party/worker
scripts.check: npm run check:docs && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.check:release: npm run check && npm run build && npm run preflight && npm run test:e2e
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n worker,web "npm run dev -w @cipher-party/worker" "npm run dev -w @cipher-party/web"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
